Message:
drm/amd/display: Enable dpia support for dcn314

[Why]
DCN 3.1.4 supports DPIA.

[How]
 - Set dpia_supported flag for dcn314 in dmub_hw_init()
 - Remove comment that becomes irrelevant after this change.
